decisions.reason: Because this workstation builds on the firm’s established coding and marking capabilities and the firm has strong in-house R&D and service knowledge to refine it, management would likely keep it despite somewhat weaker early market prominence on the website.

As a high-resolution thermal inkjet printer close to the firm’s core offer, supported by the firm’s own R&D, production-line integration know-how and favorable growth conditions, it is very likely to be retained.

This piezo inkjet printer is also closely related to the firm’s existing knowledge base and Industry 4.0 direction, so management would expect to learn from early market experience and keep developing it rather than withdraw it.
